in_sanskrit.name: चिनुपा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has the feet that bring peace and happiness (चिन्तनम् = peace and happiness, चिन्तन = to think, ponder, or reflect upon, पा = feet)

in_hindi.name: चिनुपा
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who has the feet that bring peace and happiness (चिन्तन = peace and happiness, पा = feet)

in_telugu.name: చినుపా
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who has the feet that bring peace and happiness (చిన్న = peace and happiness, పా = feet)

in_marathi.name: Chinupa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chinupa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chinu means graceful, Chupa means adorable, loved, or cherished.

in_bengali.name: Chinupa
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Graceful, Adorable
in_bengali.long_meaning: Chinupa একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Chinu means graceful, Chupa means adorable, loved, or cherished.
